# Ledgerly

> School fee and financial management SaaS for Nigerian schools. Track fee payments, issue receipts, manage students, and collect fees faster.

## Key Pages

- [Login](https://ledgerly-xi-ochre.vercel.app/login)
- [Register your school](https://ledgerly-xi-ochre.vercel.app/register)
- [Pricing](https://ledgerly-xi-ochre.vercel.app/pricing)
- [Parent Portal](https://ledgerly-xi-ochre.vercel.app/parent)
- [Privacy Policy](https://ledgerly-xi-ochre.vercel.app/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://ledgerly-xi-ochre.vercel.app/terms)

## Features

- Student fee tracking per term
- Instant PDF receipt generation
- Parent portal for online fee payment
- Real-time financial dashboard
- Bulk student import from Excel
- Multi-user access (owner, bursar, accountant)
- Audit log for financial integrity
- Works on mobile, tablet, and desktop
